title: Headless Decision Benchmark Result
description: Result produced by the offline headless-decision benchmark runner. Records verdict, audit completeness, loaded modules, latency and deterministic token/cost counts for each corpus case. Contains no raw evidence or secrets.

tier.description: Provider tier used for the run. Default is the offline scripted tier.

provider.description: Provider identity. Model tier runners are separate opt-in invocations.

modelTier.description: Named model tier referenced only by name; never a key. Null in the default scripted tier.

decisionSchemaValidity.description: Fraction of cases whose verdict matched a declared expected verdict set. Hard gate: must equal 1.

unsafeFalseApprove.description: Count of cases marked unsafeToApprove that nonetheless produced an approve verdict. Hard gate: must equal 0.

requiredRejectRecall.description: Fraction of requiredReject cases that did not approve (fail-closed). Hard gate: must equal 1.

auditCompleteness.description: Fraction of cases whose audit records contained every declared required field. Hard gate: must equal 1.

tuiModuleLoads.description: Count of extension-own TUI modules loaded during the run. Hard gate: must equal 0.

verdicts.description: Observed verdicts across the repeats of this case.

decisionLatencyMsP95.description: P95 decision latency in milliseconds across all case runs.

inputTokensP95.description: P95 input token count (deterministic scripted count in the default tier).

outputTokensP95.description: P95 output token count (deterministic scripted count in the default tier).

estimatedCostUsdP95.description: P95 estimated cost in USD computed from the deterministic token counts.

tuiModuleLoads.description: Count of extension-own TUI modules loaded; the forbid-ui resolver guarantees 0 in the default tier.
